Description: This merc has taken to adventuring for research purposes.
This merc has lost their memory and isn't sure why they're here at all.
This merc is only here because they were bored.
This merc is here because they believe they were called to the life of a mercenary by a celestial being.
This merc has been subjected to a powerful curse.
Used to Be Someone
This person was pushed into mercenary life against their will.
This person took up the life of a mercenary because it's really all that's left in this economy.
This merc was exiled from their land of origin for some heinous crime they commited.
This merc was exposed to a substance that left them permanently changed.
This merc killed someone for the first time... an act that has had lasting impacts leading to their life as a mercenary.
This merc feels guilty for having survived something they perhaps shouldn't have.
This merc had their heart broken so detrimentally they're ready to throw their life away.
This merc is on a divine mission from their chapel, temple, or divine order!
This merc sees no honor in death outside of battle, so that is what they are seeking, not wishing to die comfortably.
This merc is in serious debt that only grueling, steady mercenary work could feasibly get them out of.
This merc is the last surviving member of a once-proud lineage.
This merc wants to make their name known in the history books. Whether this is the way to do it... well, that remains to be seen.
This merc is the sole survivor of a truly traumatic event.
This merc thinks they have nothing left to live for after losing someone they dearly loved.
Don't look into this merc's swirling eyes for too long or you may just get the same madness that plagues their own mind.
This merc is clearly going through something and you're not sure they're really cut out for this work.
This merc may not be who they claim to be...
Something happened to this merc that left them permanently on-edge.
This merc has sworn an oath, be that to a king, a demon, or even themselves. That oath guides them.
This merc thought they left this life behind, but some situation has forced them back into the world of mercenary work.
This merc has never forgotten their roots and never will.
This merc knows the world doesn't revolve around them, and they're okay with that; they're happy riding along in the passenger seat of someone else's journey.
This merc was robbed of something quite valuable, and they're determined to get it back.
Someone loved by this merc has fallen gravely ill to an unknown disease. This merc is hoping to find a cure to the illness on their travels.
This merc was once part of a crew, but is the sole survivor of a brutal shipwreck.
This merc has some sort of power sleeping within them... a power they simply cannot control.
This merc isn't really sure why they're doing this. They never thought they needed a reason.
Once, this individual held a seat of significant power. That was taken from them and the thieving party now rules in their stead. They may hold a grudge.
This merc claims to receive occasional visions of something vague. They're not sure what it means, but they're convinced the visions are prophetic.
This merc swears they have already been here and done that, having reached the peak of their adventuring career and foolishly made a wish to do it all over again. Pretty hard to believe.
This merc didn't stop learning just becomes school's out!
This merc has made an alliance with some sort of criminal underlord.
This merc has encountered a previously-undiscovered magical artifact that has provided keen, unique insights.
This merc has killed someone of significant station.
This merc made a terrible mistake that came back to haunt them in a truly dreadful way while on a contract.
This merc got into a bar fight, which... they may have started.
Drawbacks: You Guys Wanna Start a Fight?

Description: This merc was betrayed by someone they trusted.
This merc has cast so many hemomancy spells that have taken a toll on their body that they're practically used to the blood loss, by now.
This merc has become great pals with another merc! That's great, as long as it doesn't get in the way of their responsibilities.
This merc was horribly burned, resulting in permanent scarring and a twisted obsession with the very thing that harmed them.
This merc has spent considerable time under the rigorous training of a renowned champion.
This merc has spent considerable time under the studious teachings of a wise individual.
This merc took a cowardly way out of a dangerous situation. They may never live that down.
This merc has pulled off a crazy acrobatic stunt during a contract! Everyone was so impressed that they'll likely keep pulling stunts like that.
This merc witnessed the death of another mercenary, which has forced them to reckon with their own mortality... and the mortality of their companions.
This merc has thrown a grenade a time or two, to great effect! After so much time spent with grenades, they consider themselves a pro.
The words spoken by this merc really are like sticks and stones. They truly can hurt.
This merc is well-experienced in the act of dissection, using it to procure valuable materials from kills, perform autopsies, and similar responsibilities.
This merc has no real respect for authority, which may get them into trouble now and then, but also makes them strong in their will and beliefs.
This merc has assumed a role that sees them giving words of affirmation and encouragement to their allies both in the field and back in the tavern.
After a successful contract in [ENVIRON], this merc considers themselves an expert in locations of that type.
This merc has successfully taken down a [Type], learning a great deal about creatures of this type in the process.
This merc has a great deal of practice with mundane healing items like gauze and skin sealant.
When the team was depending on them, this merc let them down. They really dropped the ball, but they swear they'll never let it happen, again.
This merc is incredibly fragile, but they pack a punch that more than makes up for that. So long as they can get the first hit in, they'll likely make it back home from a violent contract.
Others tend to come to this merc for therapy, even though they have no real professional training in that field.
This merc works out.
This merc has really been through it with the rest of their party. All of them have seen the worst of the worst. While that has taken its toll, it has also made them stronger.
After being held captive, trapped, or otherwise sealed off from the rest of the party during a contract, this merc has developed intense claustrophobia. They refuse to be confined, again.
Somehow, this merc has pulled off the shot of the century. Not only was the distance absurd, but the point hit on the target was impressive, too!
This merc has fallen in love with [Beau]. This could present an HR nightmare...
This merc has continued to hone their skills in a particular field, ensuring they continue to get better at it.
This merc was taken against their will from the rest of the party during the contract. Their treatment was brutal and they're glad they made it out alive.
Perks: Eyes in the Back of My Head

Description: This merc has successfully laid an ambush for a party, even if it took quite a bit of patience to execute the ambush so effectively.
This merc has assumed a leadership position while on a contract and took quite a liking to the role.
After successfully crafting and maintaining a disguise for themselves during a contract, this merc considers themselves a master of the craft.
This merc was pulled back from the brink, successfully throwing off life-threatening injuries or conditions that should have been their end.
After barely escaping from an explosion, this merc still bears the scars from the encounter. Having seen such a blast reduce matter to ash, they're not keen let that happen to them, next time.
Things didn't go this merc's way at first, but they turned it around. It's a habit of theirs.
Perks: Laugh in the Face of Danger

Description: This merc thought they were the fastest out there, til they found someone or something even faster. Now they're determined to raise their speed so they're never outmatched again.
This merc has made a pact with the [PACT BEING], gaining power in exchange for the promise of service to this being.
This merc evaded pursuers in an almost otherworldly fashion, impressively dancing out of danger.
This merc drove reckless, maneuvering a vehicle in an unsafe way, but made it out safely.
This merc returned to their home and may have regressed a bit as a result, yet simultaneously gleaned some family knowledge.
After much time spent meditating, this merc has achieved incredible peace in their mind and life.
This merc has cast so many self-harming spells from Osteomancy, Hemomancy, or even Necromancy Spell Schools that their body is permanently scarred by the magic.
This merc has eaten some truly disgusting things. They must have a stomach of steel.
This merc has sworn a [VOW] to someone - be it a king, a loved one, or themselves - that now guides their life.
This merc can sell just about anything... and they have. They just talked someone into buying something for way more than it was worth.
This merc spent a bit of time in Spectral, leading to them being permanently touched by its terrible, ghastly environment.
This merc got the drop on an enemy through an excellent tactical maneuver. Now that they see how advantageous that can be, they're likely to keep trying that.
This merc is quite tactical in battle, having executed some impressive tactics in the past using a variety of weapons.
This merc has taken some hits that should have killed other mercenaries, yet has remained standing through it all.
This merc spent 90 days training at the Temple of [TEMPLE]. This time was grueling, yet enlightening and educational. Now, they're ready to get back into the fray with their newfound capabilities.

This merc allowed their quarry to get away. Since then, they've spent a great deal of time practicing to ensure they don't let that happen again, running through alleys, rooftops, and natural terrain to hone their skills.
This merc managed to get somewhere they weren't supposed to be... totally unnoticed.
This merc snapped while on a contract, likely due to significant trauma they experienced.
This merc won a contest of great renown, emerging victorious before a crowd of hundreds of cheering onlookers who now know their name. This notoriety could be good for business!

Death is already gruesome enough without the need for violence, but this merc didn't care about that in the moment. They did something so brutal and grisly it shocked their fellow mercs... and themselves.
This merc has married another merc in your tavern! How sweet. May they live happily ever after.
Perks: Something to Hold Onto, Something to Live For, Something to Wake Up To

Description: This merc has experienced the bizarre realm of the Weird and is forever tainted by it.
This merc has read an impressive number of books on a variety of topics, primarily focusing on fictional works. These books include mysteries, poetry, literary fiction, and more!
After toiling away in the sun, this merc unearthed significant treasure! Now, they've got a knack for finding such things.
This merc swears they're not too old for this nonsense, and they seem to be capable despite their age.
This merc is staunch in their beliefs, absolutely determined that they are right in every belief they hold. It's kind of annoying.
This merc took a ride on an airship and now believe they know everything there is to know about maintaining and operating one.
